title: 第51章 我过来，不是来讲理的！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 呵！”然而，面对众人的指责，面对唐敬的怒斥，太子的嘲讽以及众人的戏谑……唐逸也只是轻笑一声。“可笑，唐画，你是不是觉得几句话煽动下，就能颠倒黑白了？”他搬过来一张椅子，拖着椅子向前走去。目标很明确，林竹！这个女人让妹妹遍体鳞伤，全身上下没有一块好肉。那么小小的孩子，她竟然敢下此毒手，那她就得有付出代价的觉悟！“我今日过来，就不是来讲理的，也不是来听你们讲理的。”“在我这里，谁伤害我妹妹……就算有天大的理由，也别给我扯道理。”“我妹，就是道理！”话落，唐逸手中的椅子直接向着不远处的林竹砸了过去。林竹吓得尖叫一声，转身就逃，周围的宾客更是吓得四处逃散，尖叫连连。谁也没想到太子还在，并且太子都出言阻止了，唐逸竟然还敢悍然出手，而且是下死手！轰的一声，椅子重重砸在桌上，当场砸得四分五裂，桌上的美酒佳肴也都散了一地。而唐逸趁着混乱，已经冲了过去，林竹没逃出几步，便已经被唐逸抓住，重重按在满是汤汁的桌上。“她年纪那么小，那么天真，对这个世界的一切都充满友好，从未以邪恶心思揣测过任何人。”“你，是怎么下得了手的！”唐逸声音冰冷，落在林竹的耳中仿佛死神的轻语。那铺天盖地的杀意将她包裹，她吓得浑身颤抖，这一刻终于体验到了什么叫死亡的恐惧。“唐逸，我错了……”林竹下意识道歉。只是话没说完，唐逸已经抓起了桌上的筷子，狠狠地向她摊在桌上的手扎了下来。“唐逸，你敢！”“唐逸，你放肆！”“……”太子，唐敬，颜霜玉的声音齐齐响起，想要阻止。然而唐逸充耳不闻，筷子瞬间将她手掌扎穿。“我，不接受道歉！”同时，他冰冷的声音响起。“啊！”林竹手捧着被筷子扎穿的手臂，惨叫声席卷整个天香楼。她想怒骂，想诅咒，想要唐逸不得好死，但话到嘴里全都化为了惨叫……她怕死，不敢触怒唐逸。听着林竹凄厉的惨叫声，又看着按着林竹的少年，众人只觉得脑袋嗡嗡响，头皮发麻。太狠了！他们还第一次见到如此果断狠戾的少年郎。唐敬脸色铁青，愤怒得如同一头困兽，呼吸都带着低沉的咆哮。毁了，全毁了，好好的庆功宴，成了唐家的杂耍宴了。颜霜玉已经花容失色，脸上没有了往日的温柔，她面色苍白而怨毒，恨意滔天。该死的贱种，贱种，你毁了我儿的宴会，你毁了我儿！唐画看着唐逸，却是下意识地退了两步，心头莫名地发寒。以前，他从未正眼看过唐逸。但现在的唐逸，让他莫名地感到恐惧。太子脸上的和煦笑容不见了，取而代之的是难以掩饰的愤怒，敢在他面前如此狂妄的人，唐逸还是第一个。天香楼外，那个坐在偏僻角落中喝酒的老太监，脸上难得有了笑容。杀伐果断，没有半点拖泥带水，这就是情报中所说的废物？这小子，有故事啊！“抱歉，诸位，打扰大家的雅兴了。”唐逸随手将林竹丢在桌上，冲着众人拱手道：“我的事办完了，这就走，你们接着奏乐接着舞，喝好吃好。”闻言，众人顿时都满脸黑线。这人心惶惶，满地狼藉，还怎么吃好喝好？“唐逸！逆子！逆子……”唐敬回过神，指着唐逸暴跳如雷，气得说不出话来。唐逸没有理会他，转身往天香楼外走去。他一路走出，沿途的人都主动让开了路，和他拉开距离。“站住！”太子忍无可忍，冷漠开口：“孤说的话，你没听到？”“听到了，又如何？”唐逸冷笑，“教我做事，你，还没有这个资格！”唐逸脚步没停，没看太子一眼。俨如太子之前夸赞唐家三兄弟，没将他放在眼里一般。“作为一国太子，现在北狄大军压境，国难当头，你该想的是如何替陛下分忧。”“而非费尽心思拉拢权臣，钩心斗角……说句实话，像你这种太子，一般在历史上，不会有太好的下场。”他半点不客气，当场就怼了回去。萧策，老将军，老王爷三人加起来都超过两百岁了，但他们还在殚精竭虑，还在为大炎的未来担忧。就连他这个异界来客，都希望这个国家能强大起来，不被其他国家欺凌。而当朝太子，风华正茂，想的却不是大炎安危，而是巩固自己位置，结党营私，不顾江山与百姓。这样的储君，能是什么好东西！但他这话一出，所有人都呆住了。听到了什么？这家伙竟然教太子做事，还将太子训成了孙子？这……太疯狂了啊！这家伙难道不知道什么叫祸从口出吗？他难道不知道诽谤蔑视皇族，也是死罪吗？唐画眸色阴狠，连唐浩也忘记挣扎了，嘴巴张大，得罪太子，他死定了。“逆子，你给我闭嘴，还不速速跪下，给太子殿下赔罪。”一波未平一波又起，唐敬吓得心惊肉跳，差点没当场去世。虽然他不喜欢唐逸，这混账还将庆功宴搅得一团糟，但也不想唐逸因此而送命。太子也愣住了，他贤名在外，走到哪谁不是客客气气地接待？现在唐家一个不成器的少年，竟然当众训斥他，骂他不懂为皇帝分忧。真真是找死啊！太子心头怒火中烧，杀心四起，但面上却依旧保持着温和笑容，不能因为这个废物，就毁了他经营十几年的好形象。但不杀他，难消他心头之怒。“受教了。说得对，如今大炎内忧外患，孤荒废国事，私自外出参加宴会，着实不该。”太子走出，冲着唐逸的背影拱手一礼，道：“只是，你作为臣子，在孤面前伤人，在孤面前上蹿下跳，将孤置于何地，将大炎律法置于何地？”“于情于理，孤今日……都不能纵容于你。”洪竹一挥手，等候在外面的十几个太子卫立即围了过来，堵住唐逸的去路。
content_en: Oh!"However, in the face of everyone's accusations, Tang Jing's angry rebuke, the prince's ridicule and everyone's teasing... Tang Yi just chuckled. "It's ridiculous, Tang Hua, do you think that with a few words of incitement, right and wrong can be reversed?"He moved a chair and dragged it forward. The goal is clear, Lin Zhu! This woman has left her sister covered in bruises, and there is not a good piece of meat in her body. For such a small child, she dares to do such a cruel thing, then she must be willing to pay the price! "I came here today not to reason, nor to listen to your reasoning."Whoever hurts my sister here...even if there is a big reason, don't give me any excuses.""My sister, that's the truth!""After saying that, the chair in Tang Yi's hand smashed directly towards Lin Zhu who was not far away. Lin Zhu screamed in fright, turned around and ran away. The surrounding guests were even more frightened and fled in all directions, screaming again and again. No one expected that the prince was still there, and the prince had spoken to stop him. Tang Yi actually dared to attack so brazenly, and with a deadly blow! With a bang, the chair hit the table hard.It was smashed to pieces on the spot, and all the food and wine on the table were scattered on the floor.Tang Yi took advantage of the chaos and rushed over. Before Lin Zhu could escape a few steps, he was caught by Tang Yi and pressed hard on the table full of soup."She is so young, so innocent, and is friendly to everything in this world. She has never thought of anyone with evil intentions."How did you do it?""Tang Yi's voice was cold, and it fell in Lin Zhu's ears like the whisper of death. The overwhelming murderous intent enveloped her, and she was so scared that she trembled with fear. At this moment, she finally experienced what the fear of death is. "Tang Yi, I was wrong..." Lin Zhu apologized subconsciously. But before she could finish her words, Tang Yi had already grabbed the chopsticks on the table and stabbed her hands on the table fiercely. "Tang Yi, you dare!"Tang Yi, you are so presumptuous!""..." The voices of the prince, Tang Jing, and Yan Shuangyu all rang out, trying to stop her. However, Tang Yi turned a deaf ear and the chopsticks instantly pierced her palm. "I don't accept the apology!""At the same time, his cold voice sounded. "Ah!"Lin Zhu held her arm that was pierced by chopsticks, and screams swept through the entire Tianxiang Tower. She wanted to curse, curse, and want Tang Yi to die a good death, but all her words turned into screams... She was afraid of death and did not dare to offend Tang Yi. Listening to Lin Zhu's miserable screams and looking at the young man holding Lin Zhu down, everyone felt their heads buzzing and their scalps numb..So cruel!This is the first time they have seen such a decisive and cruel young man.Tang Jing's face was as green as a trapped animal, and his breathing was ruined.The good celebration banquet had become a side show of the Tang family.Yan Shuangyu's face had lost its former gentleness, and her face was pale and resentful.The hatred is overwhelming.Damn you bitch, you ruined my son's banquet!Tang Hua looked at Tang Yi and took two steps back subconsciously.He had never looked at Tang Yi directly, but now he felt inexplicably scared.Tang Yi was the first person who dared to be so arrogant in front of him.Outside Tianxiang Tower, the old eunuch sitting in a remote corner had a rare smile on his face.He was decisive and not sloppy at all.Is this the trash that the intelligence said?"Sorry, everyone, I'm disturbing everyone's enjoyment.Tang Yi casually threw Lin Zhu on the table, cupped his hands in front of everyone and said, "I'm done with my business, let's go now, you can continue to play music and dance, have a good drink and eat well.""Hearing this, everyone's faces suddenly turned black. This man is so frightened and the ground is so messy, how can he eat and drink well? "Tang Yi!Treason!Duzi..." Tang Jing came back to his senses and pointed at Tang Yi, furious and speechless. Tang Yi ignored him and turned around and walked out of Tianxiang Tower. As he walked out, everyone along the way took the initiative to get out of the way and distance themselves from him. "Stop!The prince couldn't bear it anymore and said coldly: "Didn't you hear what I said?""I heard it, so what?"Tang Yi sneered, "Teach me how to do things, you are not qualified yet!""Tang Yi didn't stop and didn't look at the prince. It was as if the prince had praised the three brothers of the Tang family before but didn't take him seriously. "As the prince of a country, now that Beidi's army is approaching and the country is facing a national crisis, what you should be thinking about is how to share your majesty's worries."Instead of trying hard to win over powerful officials and scheming... To be honest, a prince like you usually doesn't end well in history."" He was not polite at all and retorted on the spot. Xiao Ce, the old general, and the old prince were all over two hundred years old together, but they were still thinking hard and worried about Dayan's future. Even he, a visitor from another world, hoped thatThis country can become strong and not be bullied by other countries.But the current prince, in his prime, does not think about the safety of Great Yan, but consolidates his position, forms a party for personal gain, and does not care about the country and the people.What good can such a prince be.Something!But when he said this, everyone was stunned.What did this guy teach the prince to do and make him a grandson?This is so crazy!Doesn’t this guy know what it means to speak out?Don't you know that slandering and contemptuous of the royal family is also a capital crime?Tang Hua's eyes were so sinister that even Tang Hao forgot to struggle and opened his mouth wide. He is dead for offending the prince."Treason, shut up and kneel down quickly to apologize to the prince."One wave after another, Tang Jing was so frightened that he almost died on the spot. Although he didn't like Tang Yi, and this bastard made a mess of the celebration banquet, but he didn't want Tang Yi to die because of it. The prince was also stunned. He had a good reputation, and who didn't receive him politely wherever he went? Now the Tang family is useless.The young man actually reprimanded him in public and scolded him for not knowing how to share the emperor's worries.He was really looking for death!The prince was filled with rage and murderous intentions, but he still kept a gentle smile on his face. He couldn't ruin the good image he had maintained for more than ten years because of this waste."You've learned a lesson.That's right. Nowadays, Great Yan is worried about internal and external troubles. It is really inappropriate to go out to attend banquets privately and neglect state affairs alone."The prince walked out, bowed his hands at Tang Yi's back, and said: "It's just that as a minister, you hurt others in front of me, jumped up and down in front of me, where did you leave me?
title_en: Chapter 51 I’m not here to reason!
